title: Dixon Ticonderoga Recalls Creativity Street Children's Assorted Craft Buttons Due to Violation of Federal Lead Content Ban
summary: The recalled children's craft buttons contain levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 890.

title: Grizzly Industrial Recalls Wood Lathes Due to Injury and Laceration Hazards
summary: The wood lathe's cutting tool can break, posing an injury hazard due to projectiles that can strike the user and bystanders, and a laceration hazard to the user who could come into direct contact with the cutting tool. Units: About 21,300 (In addition, about 60 were sold in Canada).

title: Lochinvar Recalls Condensing Boilers Due to Risk of Carbon Monoxide Poisoning
summary: The boiler's flue collector can crack if exposed to a high impact event in the burner chamber, which can allow the boiler to emit carbon monoxide, posing a risk of carbon monoxide poisoning. Units: About 17, 370 (In addition, about 782 units were sold in Canada).

title: Murf Electric Bikes Recalls Electric Bicycles Due to Fall and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The bicycles do not meet the U.S. safety standard, posing fall and injury hazards to the rider. Units: About 9,000.

title: UncleWu Life Recalls Infant Bath Seats Due to Drowning Hazard; Violation of Bath Seat Requirements; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The bath seats fail to meet the federal safety regulation for infant bath seats, including requirements for stability and leg openings, and can tip over while in use, posing a drowning hazard to babies. Units: About 360.

title: Yoocaa Baby Loungers Recalled Due to Suffocation Risk and Fall and Entrapment Hazards; Fails to Meet Safety Requirements for Infant Sleep Products; Exclusively on Amazon.com by Yoocaa Direct
summary: The recalled loungers fail to meet the safety requirements of CPSC's Infant Sleep Products Rule, creating an unsafe sleeping environment for infants and posing a suffocation risk and fall and entrapment hazards to infants. title: Khaite Recalls Women's High Heeled Sandals Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The heels on the shoes can detach, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 1,860.

title: Stainless Steel Children's Cups Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Lead Content Ban; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com by LAOION (Recall Alert)
summary: The bottom exterior of the stainless-steel cups contains an accessible solder bead with levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. In addition, the lid can crack and break during use producing sharp edges

title: Target Recalls Hearth & Hand™ with Magnolia Toy Mushroom Peg Sorters Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The stems of the toy mushrooms can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,850.

title: Tractor Supply Company Recalls Red Shed Hammock Swing Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: A plastic buckle that supports the back of the chair can break when a consumer is seated in the chair, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 7,500.

title: Amer Sports Winter & Outdoor Recalls Ski Touring Bindings Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The toe component of recalled ski bindings can fail, causing the ski boot to disconnect from the ski, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 4,250 (In addition, about 1,446 were sold in Canada).
link: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2024/Amer Sports Winter & Outdoor Recalls Ski Touring Bindings Due to Fall and Injury Hazards

title: Children's Nightgowns Recalled Due to Burn Hazard and Violation of Federal Flammability Standards; Sold by iMOONZZZ Exclusively on Amazon.com
summary: The children's nightgowns fail to meet the flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 13,300.

title: DR Power Equipment Recalls Tow-Behind Field & Brush Mowers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The exhaust pipe can break and cause damage to the unit due to excessive heat, especially in the presence of dry cuttings or spilled fuel, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 2,930 (In addition, 102 were sold in Canada).

title: IKEA Expands Recall of Mirrors Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The plastic fittings that attach the mirror to the wall can break, causing the mirror to fall, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 14,600 (In addition, about 10,500 were sold in Canada) (About 22,400 were previously recalled in March 2023).

title: Magnolia Market Recalls 3-Wick Glass Candles Due to Fire and Laceration Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled Magnolia 3-wick candles were manufactured with the incorrect wax, which can cause excessive flames on the wicks and cause the glass candle containers to break, posing fire and laceration hazards. Units: About 4,350.

title: Polaris Recalls RANGER Off-Road Vehicles Due to Fire and Crash Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: An improperly installed center brake line can cause the rear brake circuit to remain pressurized during operation, resulting in overheated brakes and reduced braking performance, posing fire and crash hazards. Units: About 1,025 (In addition, about 40 were sold in Canada).

title: Textron Specialized Vehicles Recalls Arctic Cat and Tracker Side by Side Recreational Off Highway Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicle can move when on an incline and "park" is displayed on the digital dash. This can allow the vehicle to roll away, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 6,800 (In addition, about 700 were sold in Canada).

title: Textron Specialized Vehicles Recalls E-Z-GO PTV And Tracker OX EV Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicle's internal motor wiring can become damaged over time. Under certain conditions, this issue can cause the vehicle to move unintentionally. This movement poses a crash hazard. Units: About 1,660 (In addition, about 60 were sold in Canada and about 20 were sold in Mexico).

title: Twin-Star International Recalls Infrared Quartz Electric Fireplaces Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Lowe's
summary: The electric fireplaces can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 14,670.

title: Berkshire Blanket & Home Company Recalls Heated Throws and Blankets Due to Fire and Thermal Burn Hazards
summary: The electric throws and blankets may overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 29,840.

title: GE Appliances, a Haier Company, Recalls Electric Cooktops Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The cooktop's burners can remain on after use, even after being turned to the "off" position, due to misaligned burner knob stems and fractured burner knob components that can exist in units manufactured between July 2022 and September 2022, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 11,000.

title: Klickpick Home Recalls Stainless Steel Children's Cup Sets Due to Violation of Federal Lead Content Ban; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The bottom exterior of the stainless-steel cups contains an accessible solder bead with levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. In addition, the lid can crack and break during use producing sharp edges

title: Pack and Play Mattresses Recalled Due to Suffocation Hazard for Infants; Violations to the Federal Safety Regulation for Crib Mattresses; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com by DODO Baby House (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled mattresses violate multiple provisions of the federal safety regulation for crib mattresses, including the thickness test and missing warnings and labels. The product poses a suffocation hazard to infants. Units: About 1,650.

title: Peg Perego Recalls Inclined Sleeper Bassinets for YPSI and Z4 Strollers Due to Risk of Suffocation and Fall Hazard; Violation of Federal Safety Standards (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled bassinets violate the Safe Sleep for Babies Act because they were marketed for infant sleep and have an incline angle greater than 10 degrees. Infant fatalities have occurred in inclined sleeper products after the infants rolled from their back to their stomach or side while unrestraine

title: Polaris Recalls Patriot 850 MATRYX Snowmobiles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The ring gear on the primary clutch can fail, causing the clutch assembly components to come loose, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,900 (In addition, about 1,433 were sold in Canada).

title: Polaris Recalls Patriot 9R MATRYX PRO RMK and Patriot 9R MATRYX RMK KHAOS Snowmobiles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The primary (drive) clutch can fail and can cause the clutch or clutch components to come loose, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,200 (In addition, about 1,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Russound Recalls AW70V6 Loudspeakers Due to Impact Injury Injury Hazard
summary: The front baffle of the speaker can separate from the rear housing, allowing the speaker to fall from its installed location, posing an impact injury hazard to people or property below. Units: About 4,600 (In addition, about 600 in Canada).

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Supacaz Brand Orbitron Pedals Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The pedal body can detach from the pedal spindle and/or the pedal spindle can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 3,000 (In addition, 169 were sold in Canada and 7 were sold in Mexico).

title: Tiblue Stainless Steel Children's Cups Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Lead Content Ban; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com by FENGM (Recall Alert)
summary: The bottom exterior of the stainless-steel cups contains an accessible solder bead with levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban. title: Vibe Bear Playyard Mattresses Recalled Due to Suffocation Hazards for Infants; Violation of the Federal Safety Regulation for Crib Mattresses; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com by Beyond Baby (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled mattresses violate multiple provisions of the Safety Standard for Crib Mattresses, including the firmness and thickness tests and missing warnings and labels. The product poses a suffocation hazard to infants. Units: About 820.

title: Balloon Time Mini Helium Tanks Recalled by Worthington Industries Due to Injury Hazard
summary: Compressed helium from the tank can escape and cause the plastic cap to be released into the air unexpectedly, posing an injury hazard due to projectiles striking users and bystanders. Units: About 121,100.

title: Lenovo Recalls USB-C Laptop Power Banks Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The power bank's internal screws can come loose, causing a short circuit and overheating of the lithium-ion battery, posing a fire hazard. Do not put lithium-ion batteries in the trash or battery recycling boxes found at various retail and home improvement stores. They can cause fires and explosions

title: MI Windows and Doors Recalls Vinyl Sliding Glass Doors Due to Serious Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The glass can separate from the frame during hurricane conditions which can pose a serious injury hazard. Units: About 1,900.

title: ZLINE Expands Consumer Options in Recall of Gas Ranges; Serious Risk of Injury or Death from Carbon Monoxide Poisoning
summary: The oven of the gas ranges can emit dangerous levels of carbon monoxide (CO) while in use, posing a serious risk of injury or death from carbon monoxide poisoning. Units: About 30,000.
